label: Gulf Coast
definition: MPC's Gulf Coast refining region: the Galveston Bay (Texas City, Texas) and Garyville, Louisiana refineries.

label: Mid-Continent
definition: MPC's Mid-Continent refining region: the Catlettsburg, Robinson, Detroit, El Paso, St. Paul Park, Canton, Mandan and Salt Lake City refineries.

label: West Coast
definition: MPC's West Coast refining region: the Los Angeles, Anacortes and Kenai refineries.

label: USGC
definition: The U.S. Gulf Coast product market of MPC Economics' USGC 3-2-1 crack series.

label: Chicago
definition: The Chicago product market of MPC Economics' Chicago 3-2-1 crack series.

label: Group 3 (Tulsa)
definition: The Group 3 product market, priced at Tulsa, of MPC Economics' Group 3-2-1 crack series.

label: LA
definition: The Los Angeles product market of MPC Economics' LA 3-2-1 crack series.

label: PNW
definition: The Pacific Northwest product market of MPC Economics' PNW 3-2-1 crack series.

label: SLC
definition: The Salt Lake City product market of MPC Economics' SLC 3-2-1 crack series.
